```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)

library(devtools)
library(biplotEZ)
library(plotly)
load_all(quiet = TRUE)

```

## Testing standard plotly

```{r cars}
plot_ly(
  data = mtcars,
  x = ~wt,
  y = ~mpg,
  type = "scatter",
  mode = "markers",
  color = ~factor(cyl),
  colors = c("#0B6E4F", "#C75146", "#E3B505"),
  text = ~paste(
    "Model:", rownames(mtcars),
    "<br>Weight:", wt,
    "<br>MPG:", mpg,
    "<br>Cylinders:", cyl
  ),
  hovertemplate = "%{text}<extra></extra>"
) |>
  layout(
    title = "Standard Plotly Scatter Test",
    xaxis = list(title = "Weight"),
    yaxis = list(title = "Miles per gallon"),
    legend = list(title = list(text = "Cylinders"))
  )
```

## Testing bipl5

```{r bipl5}
bp <- biplotEZ::biplot(iris[, 1:4]) |>
  biplotEZ::PCA() |>
  wrap_bipl5()

plot(bp)
```
